{{Quote|Clone on the run, eh, ''ner vod?'' Don't worry. Imperials don't come in here. Made sure of it.|The bartender|<ref name="O66" />}}
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the ''[[Oyu'baat]]'' [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcaf]] was staffed by a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] '''bartender'''. The [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] was both sarcastic and sympathetic toward his fellow Mandalorians, providing warnings for when a patron of the ''Oyu'baat'' had been placed on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunting]] list.<ref name="O66" /> He was also understanding toward the plight of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone]] deserters from the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] who came to [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], and was willing to keep them secret from those who would persecute the former [[Troop/Legends|troopers]]. The bartender also reached an agreement with the [[Unidentified Imperial commander (Mandalore)|commander]] of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|forces]] in charge of establishing a [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] on land leased to the Galactic Empire outside of [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]], ensuring that Imperials would remain out of the ''Oyu'baat'' [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]].<ref name="ImpCom501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This unnamed bartender first appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the novel ''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]'', written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]] and published [[September 16]], [[2008]].<ref name="O66" /> He was again featured in Traviss' subsequent novel and the next entry to the [[Republic Commando|''Republic'' and ''Imperial Commando'' series]], ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]'', published [[October 27]], [[2009]].<ref name="ImpCom501st" />
